profile_text.body:
Google Research is a research lab that publishes papers across a wide range of domains and shares its work in AI and science. The company says it publishes hundreds of papers each year and collaborates with universities, NGOs, partners, and communities worldwide. It describes its approach as human-centered and states a goal of building a world where AI is more than a tool, calling it an essential partner for researchers, scientists, clinicians, teachers, users, and businesses. Its stated areas of work include AI and machine learning foundations, responsible human-centric technology, science and societal impact, computing paradigms, and algorithms and optimization. The site also describes a research effort to combine foundation models with generative AI to accelerate geospatial problem solving.

The company is a for-profit research lab headquartered in Mountain View, California, in the United States. Its litigation record shows 281 cases in California. No specific products are listed for it.
